articles.title: Stripe’s $53 billion PayPal bid is a high-stakes play to own the future of digital payments
articles.snippet: If Stripe acquires PayPal, the real prize could be consumer wallets, stablecoin issuance or the infrastructure powering the next generation of digital payments.

articles.title: Ethics in crypto market structure ‘really not our concern,’ says Blockchain Association CEO
articles.snippet: A former CFTC commissioner urged lawmakers not to “kill all the hard work that we put in the rest of the bill” by making ethics a make-or-break issue on crypto market structure.

articles.title: Tradable’s $1B Stellar deal adds to institutional tokenization boom
articles.snippet: Tradable will bring up to $1 billion in private credit assets to Stellar, extending the blockchain’s push into institutional finance and tokenized real-world assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin $107K buyers providing ‘early signals’ of 2026 bear-market bottom: Glassnode
articles.snippet: Bitcoin realized losses appeared to be copying a reversal structure that marked previous bear-market bottoms, with $69,000 a new BTC price battleground.

articles.title: Aave launches V4 on Avalanche, laying groundwork for tokenized credit markets
articles.snippet: The deployment marks Aave V4’s first expansion beyond Ethereum and introduces lending infrastructure designed to support future markets for tokenized real-world assets.
